plain.li: I know a handful of workings well and the rest badly. I want to reach level {COUNT} before the next winter is out.
[spark:battle] I held back in the fight because I didn't trust myself with more. That has to change.
[inherited] {NAME} was teaching me the deeper workings when the end came. I'll {GOAL} and finish what we started.
[trait:Druid|trait:TM_Shaman] The land has more to teach me than I've had the patience to learn. I'm listening now.

cold.li: My power is a resource the colony underuses. I'll develop it.

cheerful.li: I'm going to get much better at this! Fewer singed eyebrows, more actual magic.

gloomy.li: The gift is wasted on someone who doesn't practice. I'll practice.

plain.li: Today a working came as easily as breathing, one I couldn't even attempt a year ago.
I've reached level {COUNT}. The power answers faster now, and it tires me less.

warm.li: I'm stronger now, and all of it is for the people here.

cold.li: Level {COUNT}. There is always more, and I'll take it.

gloomy.li: I've grown stronger. I hope I never need all of it.

plain.li: I know the forms, but I don't own them yet. I want to reach level {COUNT}.
[spark:downed] I went down too easily last time. I'm going to train until that can't happen again.
[spark:battle] We won, but I was slow. Every morning from now on, I train.
[inherited] {NAME} drilled me every morning until the end. I'll {GOAL}, the way {NAME} wanted.

blunt.li: I'm going to get better. That's all there is to say.

cold.li: A sharper fighter costs the colony nothing but my time. I'll spend it.

plain.li: The forms are mine now. My body knows them before I think of them.
Level {COUNT}. Years of drills, and today I felt every one of them pay off.

warm.li: Whatever comes over that wall now, I can stand in front of the others.

plain.li: Being good at {SKILL} isn't enough anymore. I want to know one corner of it better than anyone.
[spark:fulfilled] I watched {NAME} become the colony's expert, and I knew I wanted that for myself.
[inherited] {NAME} was close to it, so close. I'll {GOAL} in {NAME}'s place.

cold.li: Specialists are worth more than generalists. I'll specialize in {SKILL}.

cheerful.li: I'm going to be the person everyone comes to about {SKILL}!

plain.li: I've found my corner of {SKILL}, and I know it better than anyone here.
People ask me first now when it comes to {SKILL}. I like that more than I expected.

warm.li: I'm an expert in {SKILL} now. Anyone who wants to learn only has to ask.

blunt.li: Expert in {SKILL}. Now leave me to work.
